messages:
sara-support: Customer reports SSO logins started failing right after our IdP cert rotation. They get 403 at ACS and users stuck on IdP redirect loop. Tried a couple of accounts, consistent.

maya: Can you paste the error snippets from their side or our edge logs?

sara-support: From their browser: "POST /sso/acs 403" and our edge shows: `SAMLResponse signature verification failed: thumbprint mismatch`. They said rotation happened ~10m before failures.

jordan: @maya @sara-support that screams cached metadata on our poller or intermediate CDN holding old metadata. What do we have for metadata TTL and poll interval for that tenant?

maya: Poller config: poll interval 5m, backoff 30s on 5xx, metadata cache TTL in redis 15m. But there are known edge caches in front of the auth endpoint (CDN) with stale responses for metadata fetch used by some proxies.

sre-oncall: ops-bot shows a failed metadata fetch from idp.example.com at 1767778800 with 200 payload but old cert bundle. Then at 1767778900 we fetched rotated metadata with new cert. There might be a race where requests during rotation used partial bundle.

ops-bot: Deployment note: we deployed metadata-cache-fallback patch last week, which allows fallback to cached cert if new metadata fails validation for 60s.

maya: That fallback might be biting us: if the cached cert is still referenced for verification while IdP started signing with new key, our verification fails if we picked up only partial bundle. Need to confirm sequence.

sara-support: Customer timeline: rotate initiated at 1767778720, rotation completed at IdP at 1767778860, first 403s showed up at 1767778885. Matches race window.

jordan: Quick repro attempt: curl the metadata endpoint repeatedly, simulate rotation by returning mixed KeyDescriptors. I can simulate locally. Will also check our metadata watcher logs for partial parse errors.

maya: Meanwhile, mitigation for customer: ask them to clear any proxy caches and retry. Also set them to send SAMLRequest id in headers so we can directly map failures to our logs.

sara-support: Sent steps to customer: clear CDN edge cache, retry, and gave temporary workaround to accept older cert from our side by toggling tenant flag to allow-dual-cert for 10m. They accepted.

jordan: I pushed a temporary fix to metadata watcher to prefer newest valid certs and to avoid fallback to cached cert if we detect rotation window (heuristic: any metadata file with new valid cert within last 120s). Rolling to staging now.

maya: Can you also add a health check that compares current active signing thumbprints used by IdP versus the one returned in validation? That'll make detection clearer and auto-alert.

sre-oncall: Filed SRE ticket SRE-1223 to add the health check and an alert for thumbprint drift during metadata updates.

maya: For postmortem: document IdP rotation guidance for customers (coordinate rotate, keep old key temporarily active, shorter cache TTLs during rotation). Also record our fallback behavior so customers can plan.

sara-support: Customer back: after we toggled tenant flag they could log in again. They're happy for now but asked for root cause notes. I'll draft a short RCA.

jordan: Summary for RCA: partial metadata propagation during IdP cert rotation -> our poller fallback + CDN cache produced thumbprint mismatch on some requests -> temporary tenant flag allowed dual cert acceptance -> permanent fix: prefer newest cert on detection + health check + docs.

maya: Thanks. I'll assign follow-ups: dev eng for watcher change, SRE for alerting, support to update onboarding checklist.

sara-support: Closing the ticket after RCA draft and customer approval. Adding links to logs and the patch PR in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
